title: Pushy to get payment
body: It would get a better review if it wouldn’t ask me 5 times in a row to subscribe.  Ask me once a week at most or I just get annoyed
author: AVNHK

title: Totally unworthy USD$40
body:
1. The reminder alarm function doesn’t work
2. No update on reading list
3. No rewards or special event on challenge. Basically you can find a challenge list online and do it yourself. There’s no difference.

The GI of the app is fine but the function doesn’t match it’s value. Most regrettable purchase of an app.
author: Notnilcc

title: Cannot cancel subscription in-app
body: Forced to enter the app via paid trial that starts billing in 3 days but couldn’t cancel subscription
author: kev416363
